text:
The wireless charger is a convenient device that has made my life easier in many ways. I recently purchased the Samsung Wireless Charger Pad, and I have to say, I'm generally pleased with its performance.

The charger is incredibly easy to use. All I have to do is place my phone on the charging pad, and it begins charging immediately. The pad is compatible with a range of devices, including iPhones and Android phones, which is a great feature for households with multiple devices.

The charging pad is also very efficient. It charges my phone quickly, and I don't have to worry about plugging in any cables or finding a wall outlet. The pad is small enough to fit on my desk without taking up too much space, and it looks sleek with its minimalistic design.

One downside of the Samsung Wireless Charger Pad is that it doesn't charge through thicker cases. I have to remove my phone's case in order for it to charge, which can be a hassle. Additionally, the charging pad can get warm during charging, which may be concerning for some users.

Another issue I've encountered with this charger is that it doesn't work well with some USB power adapters. I had to use a Samsung adapter in order for it to charge my phone properly, which can be inconvenient if I don't have the right adapter on hand.

Overall, I would give the Samsung Wireless Charger Pad a 4 out of 5 stars rating. While it has some limitations, it's still a reliable and efficient charging solution that has made my life easier in many ways.

text: This screen protector saved my iPhone screen! I’m a full-time DoorDasher and Instacart shopper so I use my phone almost non-stop throughout the day. title: In a sea of screen protectors, this one does it’s job well.
text:
I’ve ordered a few screen protectors off Amazon, gotten some good and some bad. This one works great.

Can confirm the edges are rounded - steeper than some, but it’s not an issue. This helps prevent early cracking/peeling.

Application is easy and includes the same stickers/wipes as all the other screen protectors.

Glad it comes with 3 as I drop my phone a decent amount. Compared to some though, this one is holding together very well.

title: Successfully protected my iPhone
text: All right, I did a face plant on concrete while carrying my chainsaw. My iPhone flew out of my front pocket and also landed on the concrete. And there were lines running through the screen protector, and when I took it off, it was a spiderweb of cracks. But my iPhone screen was in perfect condition. I would totally recommend this product. And since I got the three pack, I was able to just replace it. Totally worth it.

title: Will always repurchase these
text:
I first bought this set last year when I got my new phone, I installed it improperly and got lots of air bubbles the first time. Tried a second and it fit perfectly. That protector lasted me over a year (and I drop my phone a loooooot)
I just recently had to buy another set because I went on vacation and dropped my phone FACE DOWN (the panic that I felt in that moment was insane) but once I could get a good look at it I realized the protector itself shattered completely. My phone screen though? Looks brand new, not even a single scratch.

Once I got the new package I applied a new one and once again, dropped my phone face down 🤦🏻‍♀️ (I have the worst luck I swear) and the protector cracked near the edges but once again, my phone was perfectly fine. So I will keep rebuying these as long as my unlucky streak keeps holding true, and will always recommend this brand!

title: Best protection for iPhone screen
text:

In the picture I’m bending the cracked screen protector just to show all the cracks, at least three cracks from side to side.
